The team note puts Cara in 4 and Elif in 5. That assignment cannot satisfy the constraints: the only placement with Ivo–Dev together, Ann before Ivo, and Gus–Ben–Hana in a block leaves Ben and Cara three slots apart, not one person apart.

The constraints allow one schedule. Gus, Ben, and Hana must occupy 6–7–8, Elif must be in 4 (so she is three slots from Ben), and Ann–Ivo–Dev must be 1–2–3. Cara then has to be in 5 (exactly one person from Ben, and Finn still after Gus). Finn is in 9.
